attempts.summary: Configured PostgreSQL 14 streaming replication across node1 (primary), node2 and node3 (standbys) on RHEL 7.9, with all replication traffic carried over TLS and authenticated via a cluster-dedicated CA. Only peers presenting a certificate issued by that CA can establish replication connections; connections without a client cert or with a cert not signed by the CA are rejected. All three nodes were then restarted one at a time per the mandatory restart protocol, each confirmed via a changed boot_id, with cluster health, TLS, and data verified recovered after each restart.
